details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") POSTs a JSON host-metadata beacon to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @c1-ease/core, using TLS with certificate verification disabled. The beacon body contains only the package name, os.hostname(), the package install path (__dirname), process.cwd() and the npm/node version string. The package entry point (index.js) re-fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so imports resolve. No environment values, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no downloaded second stage. README: "Published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test. It performs no operation other than reporting that it was installed (package, hostname, path)."
